observations.behavior: Adds a shared tuple of URL kwargs and uses it to check team/project identifiers in authentication, replacing a hardcoded, incomplete list.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent a token minted for one team from authenticating on a route intended for another team, if the URL does not include the expected team/project identifier. The implementation checks both the request parser context and the Django resolver match, and the shared tuple makes the check consistent across both paths.
